pages.title: Less Fuel Is Better
pages.text: Awakened Draconium can only be loaded after the reactor has cooled completely. Nuggets, ingots, and blocks all work as fuel, but charging requires at least one ingot-equivalent.$(br2)Spent fuel seems to leave Chaos material behind. More fuel means a larger Core, greater output, higher containment demand, and a wider explosion. I will use the minimum amount for my first test. Greed is not an option.

pages.title: Keep Waiting
pages.text: The Energy Injector needs a stable, uninterrupted OP supply. After charging begins, the reactor will not permit activation until the temperature reaches 2000°C and both saturation and containment exceed 50%.$(br2)As long as the Core still has any heat, the containment field must never lose power. This remains true during shutdown.

pages.title: Losing Balance
pages.text: The Energy Injector maintains the containment field, while the outer faces of the Stabilizers output OP. The more energy is extracted, the faster saturation falls.$(br2)Extract too little and saturation fills up, suppressing generation. Extract too much, or provide too little containment power, and the Core begins to destabilize. Temperature, saturation, containment, conversion... not one of them can be ignored.

pages.title: Shutdown Isn't Over
pages.text: Shut the reactor down while its readings are still stable, then maintain the containment field until the Core has stopped and cooled completely. Do not touch any component or fuel before then.$(br2)SAS can begin shutdown below 2500°C when saturation reaches 99%, but that does not remove the need for monitoring and backup power.

pages.title: See This? Run.
pages.text: If the reactor displays $(bold)Explosion Imminent$(), the chance for a normal recovery has already passed. Do not approach it. Do not break any component. Leave immediately.$(br2)Before connecting it to a permanent power grid, complete an entire charge, operation, shutdown, and cooling cycle remotely with the minimum fuel. Do not use the base as a test site.
